title: EffectPreset
description: Format of a single effect preset file consumed by the property-based cue vfilter. Built-in presets live under src/resources/cuepresets/ and user presets under ~/.local/share/missionDMX/cuepresets/.

name.description: Human-readable preset name shown in the editor. Also used as the filename stem when a user preset is saved.

description.description: Optional free-form description displayed in the preset editor.

applies_for.description: Which property this preset can be bound to.

hints.description: Optional parameters the preset exposes to the user. Each hint is referenced from kf_requests expressions by its id (e.g. {{ speed }}).

id.description: Identifier used to reference this hint from a Jinja expression.

type.description: Hint value kind. 'color' values are H,S,I strings (hue in [0,360), saturation and intensity in [0,1]).

default.description: Default value used when the user has not entered an override. Must match the declared type.

min.description: Optional inclusive lower bound for float/int hints.

max.description: Optional inclusive upper bound for float/int hints.

kf_requests.description: Ordered list of keyframe-request entries evaluated when the preset renders onto a step. Each entry advances the running time cursor by its 'duration' (in seconds). If the step is longer than the cumulative duration the list is repeated from the beginning; if it is shorter the list is truncated.

duration.description: Jinja expression that renders to the entry's length in seconds (float). May reference hint ids and use the math filters add, sub, mul, div, mod.

channels.description: Per-channel value expressions. Keys are channel names owned by the target property (e.g. 'brightness', 'pan_value', 'pan_curvesel', 'color', 'goboslot_0'). Values are Jinja expressions. Expressions resolving to an 'H,S,I' string are decoded as ColorHSI; otherwise they are treated as float.

examples.name: Circle
examples.description: This effect lets moving heads perform a circle rotation.
